name: Energy code check
description: Checks a house against an energy code's prescriptive package and mandatory minimums, from a code pack. First pack: California's 2025 Energy Code (Title 24, Part 6) for new single-family houses: climate zone by ZIP code, wall U-factors from the code's tables, insulation, windows. Also saves the envelope as a CBECC project file for the energy consultant. A guide, not a compliance document.
author: CadCraft
